summary: Added public schema_registry::write_registry<W: Write + ?Sized>(&mut W, &str) -> Result<(), serde_json::Error>. It passes the existing registry_value_with_crate_version representation directly to serde_json::to_writer, writes compact JSON without adding a newline or explicitly flushing, and preserves serialization and I/O errors. Added four integration tests covering exact output for borrowed versions including escaping and Unicode, mutable trait-object sinks, repeated writes to existing output, short writes, no flushing, failures before and after partial output with preserved BrokenPipe and PermissionDenied kinds, and WriteZero from an exhausted fixed-size sink. All required checks passed. Existing public APIs, tests, configuration, dependencies, and unrelated source files were preserved.
